name: l2_scn_0405_war_veteran_faultline_v1
about: L2 scenario seed SCN-0405 (War Veteran Faultline) overlaid on an Orion Station watch. A past civil conflict leaves veterans, grudges, and myths; a present-day crisis reactivates old loyalties and trauma. The seed is a pressure field and initial-condition template: roles, pressure axes, and knobs shape the run; expected end states are observation categories, never required endings. Root fixture only; not canon.
